# `_SYS` — engine binding surface

- **`SysModule`** — retail table VA `0x00B9A854`, 6 required cfuncs.

**GENERATED — do not edit by hand.** Regenerate with `cargo run -p mercs2_script --bin emmylua-gen`.

For IDE autocomplete on the same surface, load the paired EmmyLua stub — see `output/emmylua/mercs2/_SYS.lua` (regenerated by the same command).

See also:

- [Master binding-surface index](https://github.com/Mercenaries-Fan-Build/notes-on-the-released-game/blob/main/docs/reverse_engineer/scripting_host_binding_code_map.md) — every `luaL_Reg` table, its retail VA, and the representative cfuncs whose bodies are decoded.
- [Modding field guide](../field_guide.md) — the 17 collected traps a Shipment author should read before touching any of these bindings.

## Bindings

6 bindings on this global. `Corpus` = distinct references to the binding across the decompiled shipped Lua (both [`corpus/mercs2-luacd/src/`](../../../crates/mercs2_script/corpus/mercs2-luacd/src/) and [`corpus/mercs2-dlc-luacd/src/`](../../../crates/mercs2_script/corpus/mercs2-dlc-luacd/src/)); `0` means no shipped script calls it, which is a hint that a novel one may not have an established idiom to follow.

| Binding | Corpus calls |
|---------|-------------:|
| `_SYS._DYNAMIC_IMPORT` | 0 |
| `_SYS._DYNAMIC_REMOVE` | 0 |
| `_SYS._GETFENV` | 0 |
| `_SYS._IMPORT` | 0 |
| `_SYS._INHERIT` | 0 |
| `_SYS._MODULEINDEX` | 0 |
